name: Can kitchen cabinets be removed without damaging them so they can be reused?

mainEntity.name: Can kitchen cabinets be removed without damaging them so they can be reused?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, kitchen cabinets can be removed intact without destroying them, but it requires a careful, methodical approach. Instead of using demolition pry bars, crews back out individual screws from face frames and wall studs, score caulk lines, and detach adjoining boxes cleanly. Choosing salvage over quick demo takes more labor time and care, but it leaves the boxes usable for resale, donation, or repurposing in utility spaces like garages, laundry rooms, or basements. It also significantly reduces tear-out damage to the underlying drywall.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes. Backing out fasteners cleanly and cutting caulking lines allows cabinets to be removed intact for reuse in basements, garages, or donations.
